blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Field errors are signalled by a red border only) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
`field--invalid`, a red border (`#e5484d`); the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed, since the red border already shows where the problem
is. No message text is added, to keep the form compact.
findings.recommendation: A customer leaves the postcode field with `ABC`: a screen reader user hears nothing (no text, no `aria-invalid`), and a colour-blind user sees a border that differs from the grey one by hue only; neither learns which field is wrong nor why, so the checkout cannot be completed reliably (WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 3.3.3 Error Suggestion, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value). Render the rule's message as text under each invalid field, tie it to the input with `aria-describedby`, set `aria-invalid="true"` on the input, and keep the red border as a secondary cue. Update the spec's scenarios ("the field's border turns red") and task 1.2 to require and test the message text and its association rather than the border colour alone.
findings.title: Field errors are signalled by a red border only

findings.evidence: - The error list at the top of the form is removed.
findings.recommendation: Today `Form.tsx` renders the summary in a `role="alert"` region on submit, so screen reader users hear the errors. With it removed and nothing specified for submit, a keyboard or screen reader user who presses Pay with an untouched or invalid field hears no announcement and focus stays on the button, so they cannot tell why payment did not proceed (WCAG 2.2 3.3.1 Error Identification, 4.1.3 Status Messages). Keep an error summary on submit (with links to the fields) or move focus to the first invalid field whose message is associated with it; add a spec scenario for submitting the form with an invalid field.
findings.title: Removing the error summary leaves submit errors unannounced
